# MDD Sim Gateway v1.14.2-rc2

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- 这是 **RC 测试版**，尚未确认偶发来电失败的根因已修复。仅手动安装，自动更新目标保持 v1.14.0，最新正式版仍为 v1.14.1。
- 升级会短暂重启服务和线路。请一起升级 Control、Engine 及宿主编排器或 Hardware 容器；实际 SIM 通话和浏览器交互仍待验收。

### 1. 本次测试版更新

- **已注册时也提示代理异常**：代理数据路径故障后，IMS 注册可能仍有效，之前页面因此继续显示工作正常。现在正常提示收窄为「IMS 已注册」，后台通过当前实际出口检测 UDP；两轮连续检测失败时优先显示代理连通性警告，并保留注册事实。
- **降低日常检测频率**：正常时每 **10 分钟**检测一次，首次失败后 30 秒复核，告警期间每分钟检查恢复。页面提供最近检测时间和「重新检测」按钮；手动指定的节点和只有一个节点的出口也会检测。
- **防止沿用旧结果**：同一出口共享检测，节点或配置改变后丢弃旧结果，过期结果显示待检测。检测成功后清除警告。这些检测只用于提示，不自动切换节点或重启线路；公共 UDP 检测通过不能保证运营商的隧道、既有会话和通话正常。
- 保留 RC1 的单线路 60 分钟持续采集及来电标记。测试方法见[来电故障采集](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2-rc2/docs/VOWIFI_RECORDING.md)，提示含义见[代理连通性提示](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2-rc2/docs/PROXY_HEALTH.md)。

### 2. 当前大版本更新

保留 v1.14 的设备自定义名称、移动端布局改进及 eSIM、SIM 桥接和国家出口恢复。本版重建 amd64、arm64 Engine，并提供完整组件镜像、源码包、Compose 文件及校验和。

## English

### 0. Important notes

- This is an **RC**; the root cause of intermittent incoming-call failures is not confirmed fixed. Installation is manual, automatic update targets remain v1.14.0, and v1.14.1 remains the latest stable release.
- Upgrading briefly restarts services and lines. Update Control, Engine, and the host orchestrator or Hardware container together. Real-SIM calls and browser interaction still require validation.

### 1. Changes in this test release

- **Warn about proxy failures while IMS remains registered**: IMS registration can remain valid after a proxy data-path failure, so the page previously continued to report a working line. The normal message now says “IMS registered.” Background UDP checks use the currently selected exit; two consecutive failed rounds show a proxy warning ahead of the registration label while preserving the registration fact.
- **Reduce routine probes**: healthy exits are checked every **10 minutes**. A first failure is confirmed after 30 seconds; warned exits are checked every minute for recovery. The page shows the last check time and a recheck button. Manually selected and single-node exits are also monitored.
- **Discard outdated evidence**: lines on the same exit share probes. Node or configuration changes invalidate old results, and expired results return to awaiting a check. A successful check clears the warning. These checks are advisory: they do not switch nodes or restart lines, and a successful public UDP probe does not prove carrier tunnel, existing-session or call availability.
- RC1's opt-in 60-minute per-line recording and incoming-call markers remain available. See the [recording instructions](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2-rc2/docs/VOWIFI_RECORDING.md) and [proxy-health notes](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/v1.14.2-rc2/docs/PROXY_HEALTH.md).

### 2. Current major release

Includes v1.14 custom device names, mobile layout improvements, and eSIM, SIM bridge, and country-exit recovery. This release rebuilds amd64 and arm64 Engines and includes all component images, source, Compose files, and checksums.
